evidence.title: Linde Starts Up New Plant to Deliver Increased Capacity to Space Launch Sector
evidence.quote: The new Air Separation Unit effectively doubles production capacity at Mims to more than 500 tons per day in response to growing contracted space-launch demand.

evidence.title: Linde to Expand Production Capacity in Florida to Meet Growing Demand
evidence.quote: Linde said it would increase Mims capacity by almost 50 percent and cited growing demand for space-launch propellant and the broader regional economy.

evidence.title: Linde Signs New Supply Agreement with Major Space Launch Company
evidence.quote: Linde announced another long-term agreement to supply liquid oxygen and nitrogen and said its Mims expansion would increase capacity by up to 50 percent.

evidence.title: Linde Announces Major U.S. Investments to Support Commercial Space Sector
evidence.quote: Linde announced two long-term bulk-gas agreements, a Mims expansion, and a new Brownsville air-separation unit for commercial space operations.

dependencies.relationship: Supplies liquid oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and related industrial-gas infrastructure to commercial space-launch customers.
dependencies.materiality_basis: The issuer repeatedly committed dedicated capacity, but it does not separately disclose space revenue; current external estimates describe space as a low-single-digit share of company revenue.

events.summary: Linde started a Mims air-separation unit that doubled production to more than 500 tons per day, citing contracted launch demand.
Linde announced another nearly 50 percent Mims expansion for contracted customers including the aerospace end market.
Linde disclosed another long-term industrial-gas agreement with a major Florida launch company alongside a capacity increase of up to 50 percent.
Linde disclosed two long-term agreements plus new and expanded plants supporting U.S. commercial launch demand.
